exposure: Adjunctive azithromycin with standard antibiotic prophylaxis
outcome: Postcesarean infections (endometritis, superficial or deep wound infections, intra-abdominal abscess, urinary tract infections)
cohort: Patients with singleton pregnancies at more than 23 weeks of gestation who underwent prelabor cesarean birth at a single tertiary care center between January 2013 and December 2018
finding: Adopting adjunctive azithromycin for prelabor cesarean deliveries was associated with lower odds of postpartum infection.
